---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: scenarios
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:          "Scenario comparison"
  cmp_name:       ""
  base_name:      ""
  image_file:     NULL
  overview_df:    NULL
  objective_plot: NULL
  gen_plot:       NULL
  cap_plot:       NULL
  newcap_plot:    NULL
  emis_plot:      NULL
  emis_df:        NULL
  cost_df:        NULL
  costs_plot:     NULL
  values_df:      NULL
  top_df:         NULL
  delta_tbls:     NULL
  verify_df:      NULL
  inputs_txt:     NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r en-setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Shared helpers live in the package (see ?energyRt::report_helpers).
fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L, ...)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt, ...)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
```

```{r en-css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r en-logo, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$image_file)) emit_img(params$image_file, 0.25)
```

`r if (isTRUE(nzchar(params$base_name))) paste0("Baseline: **", params$base_name, "**. Differences are reported against it.")`

## Overview

```{r en-overview, results='asis'}
tbl(params$overview_df)
```

```{r en-objective, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.5, eval=!is.null(params$objective_plot)}
params$objective_plot
```

```{r en-costs-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, eval=!is.null(params$costs_plot)}

```

## Value differences

```{r en-values, results='asis'}
v <- params$values_df
if (!is.null(v)) {
  v <- v[!v$status %in% "identical", , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(v) > 0) tbl(v, caption = "Differing variables") else
    cat("All compared values are within tolerance.\n")
}
```

```{r en-top, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$top_df)}
tbl(params$top_df, caption = "Largest differences vs baseline")
```

```{r en-deltas, results='asis', eval=length(params$delta_tbls) > 0}
for (v in names(params$delta_tbls)) {
  energyRt::report_sec(paste0(v, " -- differing rows"), output = fmt)
  tbl(params$delta_tbls[[v]])
}
```

```{r en-verify-header, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$verify_df)}
cat("## Solution checks\n")
```

```{r en-verify, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$verify_df)}
tbl(params$verify_df)
```

```{r en-inputs-header, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$inputs_txt)}
cat("## Input differences\n")
```

```{r en-inputs, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$inputs_txt)}
cat("```\n")
cat(params$inputs_txt, sep = "\n")
cat("\n```\n")
```
